The enforcement depends on the value of enforcement_scope and the VPC-SC status of the project. If a port number is not provided, all ports will be allowed. Otherwise, the port number must match exactly. For example, "https://example.com" will match "https://example.com:443" and any other port. "https://example.com:443" will only match "https://example.com:443".

EndpointControlPolicy.description: Defines project/location level endpoint control policy.

timeout.description: Optional. The timeout for the tool execution. If not set, the default timeout is 30 seconds for `SYNCHRONOUS` tools and 60 seconds for `ASYNCHRONOUS` tools.

updateTime.description: Output only. Timestamp when the tool was last updated.

toolFakeConfig.description: Optional. Configuration for tool behavior in fake mode.

etag.description: Etag used to ensure the object hasn't changed during a read-modify-write operation. If the etag is empty, the update will overwrite any concurrent changes.

mcpTool.description: Optional. The MCP tool. An MCP tool cannot be created or updated directly and is managed by the MCP toolset.

displayName.description: Output only. The display name of the tool, derived based on the tool's type. For example, display name of a ClientFunction is derived from its `name` property.

name.description: Identifier. The resource name of the tool. Format: * `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apps/{app}/tools/{tool}` for standalone tools. * `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apps/{app}/toolsets/{toolset}/tools/{tool}` for tools retrieved from a toolset. These tools are dynamic and output-only; they cannot be referenced directly where a tool is expected.

executionType.description: Optional. The execution type of the tool.
enumDescriptions: The execution type is unspecified. Defaults to `SYNCHRONOUS` if unspecified.
The tool is executed synchronously. The session is blocked until the tool returns.
The tool is executed asynchronously. The session will continue while the tool is executing.

createTime.description: Output only. Timestamp when the tool was created.

generatedSummary.description: Output only. If the tool is generated by the LLM assistant, this field contains a descriptive summary of the generation.

readOnly.description: Output only. Indicates whether the tool is read-only. If true, the tool cannot be modified by the user.

Tool.description: A tool represents an action that the CES agent can take to achieve certain goals.

DataStore.description: A DataStore resource in Vertex AI Search.

documentProcessingMode.description: Output only. The document processing mode for the data store connection. Only set for PUBLIC_WEB and UNSTRUCTURED data stores.

enumDescriptions: Not specified. This value indicates that the data store type is not specified, so it will not be used during search.
A data store that contains public web content.
A data store that contains unstructured private data.
A data store that contains structured data used as FAQ.
A data store that is a connector to a first-party or a third-party service.
type.description: Output only. The type of the data store. This field is readonly and populated by the server.

connectorConfig.description: Output only. The connector config for the data store connection.

displayName.description: Output only. The display name of the data store.

name.description: Required. Full resource name of the DataStore. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/collections/{collection}/dataStores/{dataStore}`

createTime.description: Output only. Timestamp when the data store was created.

displayName.description: Optional. The display name of the app version.

name.description: Identifier. The unique identifier of the app version. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apps/{app}/versions/{version}`

snapshot.description: Output only. The snapshot of the app when the version is created.

etag.description: Output only. Etag used to ensure the object hasn't changed during a read-modify-write operation. If the etag is empty, the update will overwrite any concurrent changes.

description.description: Optional. The description of the app version.

creator.description: Output only. Email of the user who created the app version.

createTime.description: Output only. Timestamp when the app version was created.

updateTime.description: Output only. Timestamp when the app version was last updated.

AppVersion.description: In Customer Engagement Suite (CES), an app version is a snapshot of the app at a specific point in time. It is immutable and cannot be modified once created.

message.description: A Message object containing a message from the agent.

statusUpdate.description: An event indicating a task status update.

artifactUpdate.description: An event indicating a task artifact update.

task.description: A Task object containing the current state of the task.

LfA2aV1StreamResponse.description: A wrapper object used in streaming operations to encapsulate different types of response data.

LoggingSettings.description: Settings to describe the logging behaviors for the app.

unredactedBigqueryExportSettings.description: Optional. Configures the BigQuery export behaviors for the app. The unredacted conversation data will be exported to BigQuery tables if it is enabled.

metricAnalysisSettings.description: Optional. Settings to describe the conversation data collection behaviors for the LLM analysis pipeline for the app.

conversationLoggingSettings.description: Optional. Settings to describe the conversation logging behaviors for the app.

bigqueryExportSettings.description: Optional. Configures the BigQuery export behaviors for the app. The conversation data is subject to redaction as configured in RedactionConfig.

requiredRecordingConsent.description: Optional. Whether the app has to say what may be recorded before anything is kept. When true, a session starts with recording off and stays off until the client sends SessionInput.recording_control, which then decides every turn from that point on. This covers audio recording as well as conversation history, BigQuery export and Cloud Logging. When `false`, the default, the settings above decide on their own and the client does not have to send anything.

redactionConfig.description: Optional. Configuration for how sensitive data should be redacted.

evaluationAudioRecordingConfig.description: Optional. Configuration for how audio interactions should be recorded for the evaluation. By default, audio recording is not enabled for evaluation sessions.

audioRecordingConfig.description: Optional. Configuration for how audio interactions should be recorded. The audio is subject to redaction as configured in RedactionConfig.

cloudLoggingSettings.description: Optional. Settings to describe the Cloud Logging behaviors for the app.

unredactedAudioRecordingConfig.description: Optional. Configures an additional recording of unredacted audio. This can be used to maintain a raw audio copy when audio redaction is enabled, typically for auditing or monitoring purposes.

generativeAnswer.description: Optional. Respond with a generative answer.

transferAgent.description: Optional. Transfer the conversation to a different agent.

respondImmediately.description: Optional. Immediately respond with a preconfigured response.

TriggerAction.description: Action that is taken when a certain precondition is met.

appUri.description: The [Google Cloud Storage](https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/) URI to which the app was exported.

appContent.description: App folder compressed as a zip file.

ConversationTurn.description: All information about a single turn in the conversation.

userIntendedText.description: Optional. The intended ground-truth text from the Simulated Caller (Polysynth). Only populated when word error rate metrics are enabled.

messages.description: Optional. List of messages in the conversation turn, including user input, agent responses and intermediate events during the processing.

rootSpan.description: Optional. The root span of the action processing.

enumDescriptions: 8-bit samples that compand 14-bit audio samples using G.711 PCMU/mu-law.
8-bit samples that compand 14-bit audio samples using G.711 PCMU/A-law.
audioEncoding.description: Required. The encoding of the output audio data.

sampleRateHertz.description: Required. The sample rate (in Hertz) of the output audio data.

OutputAudioConfig.description: OutputAudioConfig configures how the CES agent should synthesize outgoing audio responses.

schemes.description: A map of security schemes to the required scopes.

LfA2aV1SecurityRequirement.description: Defines the security requirements for an agent.

OperationMetadata.description: Represents the metadata of the long-running operation.

createTime.description: Output only. The time the operation was created.

endTime.description: Output only. The time the operation finished running.

requestedCancellation.description: Output only. Identifies whether the user has requested cancellation of the operation. Operations that have been cancelled successfully have google.longrunning.Operation.error value with a google.rpc.Status.code of `1`, corresponding to `Code.CANCELLED`.

statusMessage.description: Output only. Human-readable status of the operation, if any.

passphrase.description: Optional. The name of the SecretManager secret version resource storing the passphrase to decrypt the private key. Should be left unset if the private key is not encrypted. Format: `projects/{project}/secrets/{secret}/versions/{version}`

tlsCertificate.description: Required. The TLS certificate encoded in PEM format. This string must include the begin header and end footer lines.

privateKey.description: Required. The name of the SecretManager secret version resource storing the private key encoded in PEM format. Format: `projects/{project}/secrets/{secret}/versions/{version}`

description.description: Optional. A human readable description of the artifact.

parts.description: Required. The content of the artifact. Must contain at least one part.

metadata.description: Optional. Metadata included with the artifact.

extensions.description: The URIs of extensions that are present or contributed to this Artifact.

name.description: A human readable name for the artifact.

artifactId.description: Required. Unique identifier (e.g. UUID) for the artifact. It must be unique within a task.

DataStoreTool.description: Tool to retrieve from Vertex AI Search datastore or engine for grounding. Accepts either a datastore or an engine, but not both. See Vertex AI Search: https://cloud.google.com/generative-ai-app-builder/docs/enterprise-search-introduction.

engineSource.description: Optional. Search within an Engine (potentially across multiple DataStores).

boostSpecs.description: Optional. Boost specification to boost certain documents.

dataStoreSource.description: Optional. Search within a single specific DataStore.

enumDescriptions: Default filter behavior. Include filter parameter for connector datastores. For the rest of the datastore types, the filter input parameter is omitted.
Always include filter parameter for all datastore types.
The filter parameter is never included in the list of tool parameters, regardless of the datastore type.

name.description: Required. The data store tool name.

description.description: Optional. The tool description.

modalityConfigs.description: Optional. The modality configs for the data store.

AgentSkill.description: Represents a distinct capability or function that an agent can perform.

inputModes.description: The set of supported input media types for this skill, overriding the agent's defaults.

description.description: Required. A detailed description of the skill.

id.description: Required. A unique identifier for the agent's skill.

tags.description: Required. A set of keywords describing the skill's capabilities.

name.description: Required. A human-readable name for the skill.

outputModes.description: The set of supported output media types for this skill, overriding the agent's defaults.

examples.description: Example prompts or scenarios that this skill can handle.

ErrorHandlingSettingsEndSessionConfig.description: Configuration for ending the session in case of system errors (e.g. LLM errors).

escalateSession.description: Optional. Whether to escalate the session in EndSession. If session is escalated, metadata in EndSession will contain `session_escalated = true`. See https://docs.cloud.google.com/customer-engagement-ai/conversational-agents/ps/deploy/google-telephony-platform#transfer_a_call_to_a_human_agent for details.

cert.description: Required. The allowed custom CA certificates (in DER format) for HTTPS verification. This overrides the default SSL trust store. If this is empty or unspecified, CES will use Google's default trust store to verify certificates. N.B. Make sure the HTTPS server certificates are signed with "subject alt name". For instance a certificate can be self-signed using the following command: ``` openssl x509 -req -days 200 -in example.com.csr \ -signkey example.com.key \ -out example.com.crt \ -extfile <(printf "\nsubjectAltName='DNS:www.example.com'") ```

displayName.description: Required. The name of the allowed custom CA certificates. This can be used to disambiguate the custom CA certificates.

persona.description: Optional. The persona of the channel.
enumDescriptions: The agent keeps the responses concise and to the point
The agent provides additional context, explanations, and details

ChannelProfilePersonaProperty.description: Represents the persona property of a channel.

type.description: Optional. The type of the supervisor.

enumDescriptions: Detection mode is unspecified. Default to NON_BLOCKING.
Non blocking detection mode. Response is not blocked when the supervisor detection is ongoing.
Blocking detection mode. Response is blocked when the supervisor detection is ongoing.
detectionMode.description: Optional. The detection mode of the supervisor.

WidgetToolTextResponseConfig.description: Configuration for the text response returned with the widget.

textResponseInstruction.description: Optional. Instruction for the LLM on how to generate the text response. Used as the description for the text response parameter if type is LLM_GENERATED.

enumDescriptions: The LLM dynamically decides whether to generate a text response alongside the widget based on the conversation context.
The LLM is explicitly required to generate a text response.
A pre-defined static text response is always used.
type.description: Optional. The strategy for providing the text response.

staticText.description: Optional. The static text response to return when type is STATIC.

DataStoreToolBoostSpec.description: Boost specification to boost certain documents.

conditionBoostSpecs.description: Required. A list of boosting specifications.

enumDescriptions: A fallback message will be returned to the user in case of system errors (e.g. LLM errors).
An EndSession signal will be emitted in case of system errors (e.g. LLM errors).
errorHandlingStrategy.description: Optional. The strategy to use for error handling.

endSessionConfig.description: Optional. Configuration for ending the session in case of system errors (e.g. LLM errors).

fallbackResponseConfig.description: Optional. Configuration for handling fallback responses.

ErrorHandlingSettings.description: Settings to describe how errors should be handled in the app.

ArtifactChunk.description: A streamed fragment of a document artifact (e.g. a markdown TDD) that the assistant is generating. Content deltas stream while the document is being written so clients can render a live preview; the FINALIZED chunk carries the GCS URI once the file has been persisted.

enumDescriptions: The assistant started generating the artifact.
A content increment; content_delta is set.
The artifact was persisted; gcs_uri is set.
Generation or persistence failed; the artifact was not saved.
The document finished streaming: its content was fully delivered via content_delta chunks. Persistence may still follow; a FINALIZED chunk with a gcs_uri is sent if and when the artifact is saved.

displayName.description: The file name shown to the user, e.g. "hotel_booking_tdd.md". Set on STARTED (and repeated on FINALIZED).

artifactId.description: Identifier of the artifact, stable across all chunks of one artifact within the stream.

gcsUri.description: The GCS object the artifact was persisted to. Set on FINALIZED chunks.

mimeType.description: The IANA media type of the artifact content, e.g. "text/markdown".

contentDelta.description: Incremental artifact content. Set on DELTA chunks.

caCerts.description: Required. Specifies a list of allowed custom CA certificates for HTTPS verification.

MockedToolCall.description: A mocked tool call. Expresses the target tool + a pattern to match against that tool's args / inputs. If the pattern matches, then the mock response will be returned.

toolId.description: Optional. The name of the tool to mock. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apps/{app}/tools/{tool}`

mockResponse.description: Optional. The mock response / output to return if the tool call args / inputs match the pattern.

expectedArgsPattern.description: Required. A pattern to match against the args / inputs of all dispatched tool calls. If the tool call inputs match this pattern, then mock output will be returned.
